selection_policy: Keep medical datasets as the primary evidence tier.
Add finance and science datasets only when the native files can be mapped to JSON/JSONL/CSV records.
Preserve each original paper benchmark separately from SDE-Bench common-axis evaluation.
Report candidate cells as not_applicable or requires_adapter until an adapter and command exist.

candidate_datasets.name: Health Gym ICU/HIV synthetic health datasets
candidate_datasets.original_metric: offline RL task utility, distribution/correlation similarity, disclosure risk
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: map patient trajectories to per-visit records; evaluate fidelity, privacy, diversity, validity, and structured temporal traceability
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: flatten ICU/HIV trajectories into JSONL with patient_id, time, vitals/labs/actions/outcomes
candidate_datasets.why: closest medical addition after Synthea because it is public, synthetic, longitudinal, and benchmark-oriented.

candidate_datasets.name: CMS DE-SynPUF claims
candidate_datasets.original_metric: claims analytic usefulness and privacy-preserving public release
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: map beneficiary, diagnosis, procedure, and claim tables to encounter records
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: claims parser plus ICD/procedure field normalization
candidate_datasets.why: useful for claims-style medical synthetic data, but larger and less LLM/RAG-like than KMUC.

candidate_datasets.name: SM3-Text-to-Query
candidate_datasets.native_format: synthetic Synthea-derived database plus natural-language query pairs
candidate_datasets.original_metric: text-to-query execution accuracy across SQL, MQL, Cypher, and SPARQL
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: evaluate generated patient records separately from query-pair utility
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: extract patient tables from database dumps; keep query-pair task as original-benchmark family
candidate_datasets.why: medical and synthetic, but the native benchmark targets text-to-query systems rather than dataset quality alone.

candidate_datasets.name: FiFAR financial fraud alert review dataset
candidate_datasets.native_format: tabular fraud alerts plus synthetic analyst predictions
candidate_datasets.original_metric: learning-to-defer assignment utility under capacity constraints
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: evaluate tabular fidelity/diversity/privacy with fraud label utility; report domain as finance
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: generic CSV/Parquet loader plus target=is_fraud and optional sensitive/workload columns
candidate_datasets.why: small enough to adapt and useful as a non-medical, high-stakes synthetic decision dataset.

candidate_datasets.name: Synthetic AML transaction datasets
candidate_datasets.original_metric: AML detection utility and transaction realism
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: evaluate transaction-level fidelity/diversity/privacy and label utility; add graph metrics later
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: sample transaction tables; normalize account, amount, timestamp, label, and typology fields
candidate_datasets.why: strong finance benchmark candidate, but graph/transaction scale makes it a second batch item.

candidate_datasets.name: TransXion AML benchmark
candidate_datasets.original_metric: AML detection performance plus graph/profile realism
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: evaluate only sampled tabular projections until graph-specific axes exist
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: graph-to-record projection and network metric extension
candidate_datasets.why: recent and public, but broader than the current tabular/text SDE-Bench core.

candidate_datasets.name: SynTReN synthetic gene expression generator
candidate_datasets.native_format: gene expression matrices with known regulatory structure
candidate_datasets.original_metric: network structure recovery and expression realism
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: treat genes as numeric features and pathways/classes as labels when available
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: matrix-to-record converter with sample_id, gene_* numeric columns, and optional class/condition label
candidate_datasets.why: classic synthetic science dataset where ground-truth structure is part of the benchmark value.

candidate_datasets.name: Universal synthetic spectroscopic dataset
candidate_datasets.original_metric: spectra classification accuracy across model families
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: evaluate numeric vector fidelity/diversity/privacy and class-label utility
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: spectra vector loader; optionally downsample peaks to fixed-width JSONL features
candidate_datasets.why: science-domain synthetic benchmark with clear labels, but less medically relevant.

candidate_datasets.name: SuperBench scientific ML super-resolution datasets
candidate_datasets.sde_bench_plan: out of current JSONL/tabular scope except metadata-level sampling
candidate_datasets.adapter_work: requires array/image adapter and physics-specific axes
candidate_datasets.why: topical SciML benchmark, but not a near-term fit for SDE-Bench tabular/text evaluation.
